metadata.title: European Captives Leaflet Prototype
metadata.generated_from: BC Project Captivity Complete Location Date.csv
metadata.method_note: Lines join documented origin and captivity associations. They do not reconstruct a route. Unknown source coordinates are intentionally excluded.

origin-baltimore.review_note: Identified from the 1631 Sack of Baltimore context in the source data.

origin-bermuda.review_note: Regional centroid; not a precise port or residence.

origin-boston.review_note: Probable English port; verify against the cited source before publication.

origin-chatham.review_note: Probable Kent port; verify against the cited source before publication.

origin-christchurch.review_note: Probable Dorset port; verify against the cited source before publication.

origin-dorset.review_note: Regional centroid; not a precise settlement.

origin-foulston.review_note: Tentative identification only; retain original spelling and verify before publication.

origin-gallipoli.review_note: Probable Italian port based on the source note describing an oil cargo; verify before publication.

origin-lyn.review_note: Tentative identification from historical spelling and port context; verify before publication.

origin-madeira.review_note: Regional centroid; not a precise port.

origin-millbrook.review_note: Probable Cornish port; verify against the cited source before publication.

origin-new-england.review_note: Broad regional centroid; does not identify a specific port.

origin-newfoundland-and-labrador.review_note: Broad regional centroid; does not identify a specific port.

origin-north-yarmouth.review_note: Historical North Yarmouth is treated as Great Yarmouth for this prototype; verify before publication.

origin-rochel.review_note: Historical spelling normalized to La Rochelle; source notes describe salt cargo from Rochel.

origin-st-martin-s.review_note: Tentative identification based on the salt-trade context; verify before publication.

origin-stockton.review_note: Probable English port; verify against the cited source before publication.

origin-terceras.review_note: Historical plural/variant normalized to Terceira in the Azores.

origin-warom.review_note: Tentative identification from historical spelling; verify before publication.

origin-yahall.review_note: Probable historical spelling of Youghal; verify before publication.

captivity-tripoli.review_note: Replaces #FIELD! errors in the source coordinate columns.
